snippet.title: Don't Touch the Snail - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Don't Touch the Snail, an idle meme game developed by Both Good. Players must move their cursor away from the snail for as long as possible, and if the snail does touch the cursoe the game is over forever. Don't Touch the Snail is coming soon to PC (Steam).
